d: Anant Singh Daughter Tilak:bihar ki rajniti men apne dabadbe ke lie pahchane jane vale anant sinh in dinon kisi rajnitik vajah se nahin, balki apni beti ki shadi ko lekar surkhiyon men hain.... aur is shadi ki taiyariyan aisi hain ki lagjari kar se lekar mithaiyon tak har chij charcha ka vishay ban gaee hai....kahin 400 se jyada gariyon ka kaphila najar aa raha hai, to kahin damad ke lie chamachmati Land Rover Defender taiyar khari hai....itna hi nahin, mehmanon ki khatirdari ke lie 1000 kilo shuddh desi ghi ke laddu banvae ja rahe hain....lekin saval ye hai ki aakhir anant sinh apni beti…
